annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689 and (EU) 2018/1139 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689 and (EU) 2018/1139 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal (Digital Omnibus on AI) amending the EU AI Act and Regulation 2018/1139 to simplify implementation. It delays high-risk obligations until standards are available (backstops Dec 2027/Aug 2028), extends SME privileges to small mid-caps, centralises oversight in the AI Office, and expands sandboxes and real-world testing, including for product-embedded AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Links application of high-risk rules to Commission decision on standards availability, with fixed backstops of 2 Dec 2027 (Annex III) and 2 Aug 2028 (Annex I).
Extends SME regulatory privileges (documentation, QMS, penalties) to small mid-caps.
AI Office gets exclusive supervision of GPAI-based systems and AI in VLOPs/VLOSEs, excluding Annex I product AI.
Extends real-world testing to Annex I products, plus EU-level sandbox from 2028 and voluntary testing agreements for Section B products.
Single application for notified body designation; AI literacy duty shifted to Commission and Member States; bias-detection processing of special-category data allowed.
